review_candidates.description: Job Requirements Job Location: Poland - Remote Fulltime Job Description We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Sales Manager (M/F) to drive business growth and expand our market presence across Poland and the Baltic States (Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania). In this role, you will be responsible for selling specialised anti-microbial solutions directly into the beverage industry. The ideal candidate combines a strong technical background in chemical and/or food & beverage sales with professional fluency in both a Slavic language (such as Polish) and Russian to effectively communicate with diverse regional clients. Key Responsibilities Market Expansion: Develop and execute a comprehensive strategic sales plan to capture market share within the beverage sector across Poland and the Baltic States. Client Acquisition & Management: Identify, pitch, and secure new B2B accounts with beverage manufacturers, breweries, soft drink producers, and bottling plants while nurturing existing client relationships. Technical Sales & Consultation: Serve as the primary technical liaison, providing expert consultation on chemical applications, ingredient formulation, safety standards, and regulatory compliance within beverage manufacturing processes. Pipeline & Forecasting: Maintain an accurate sales pipeline, forecast regional revenue, and report regularly on market trends, competitor activities, and sales performance metrics. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Coordinate closely with customer service, supply chain, and R&D teams to ensure smooth order fulfilment, timely product delivery, and tailored product development. Negotiation & Closing: Lead commercial negotiations, draft competitive pricing proposals, and close sales contracts aligned with company profitability targets. Work Experience Qualifications & Requirements Experience: Minimum 5 years of proven B2B sales experience within the chemical, specialty ingredients, or food & beverage manufacturing industry. Education: Bachelor’s degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Food Science, Business Administration, or a related field. Language Skills: Full professional proficiency in English, alongside fluency in Polish (or another Slavic language) and Russian. Regional Knowledge: In-depth understanding of the commercial landscape, industrial networks, and cultural nuances across Poland and the Baltic States. Ability to comfortably translate technical product features, chemical data, and application safety parameters into clear commercial benefits for beverage manufacturers. Travel Availability: Ability and willingness to travel frequently (up to 40-50%) across the assigned territory for client meetings, trade shows, and site visits. Benefits Benefits Compensation We offer competitive compensation packages, inclusive of a global bonus program and an individual bonus program (Sales Incentive Plan). Salary range: monthly gross salary 17 200 PLN – 24 000 PLN, salary is the subject of mutual agreement based on skills and experience. Comprehensive Benefits We provide a variety of benefits to support your financial security, health and wellbeing including retirement plans, health programs, life insurance and medical care. Work-Life & Flexibility We support you in maintaining a balance between working hours and personal life. With our global “Xwork” program, we offer flexible working arrangements in all countries in which we operate. Training & Development We are committed to your professional and personal development and encourage you in the ongoing pursuit of education, training and knowledge through both formal and informal learning. Diversity For us, talent matters, we welcome everyone who commits to our values. We strongly believe that including diverse perspectives makes us more innovative and enhances our competitiveness. Therefore, we embrace the uniqueness of every single individual and are truly committed to supporting our people in developing their individual potential. Contractual Note: The successful candidate will be hired by the regional legal entity, Lanxess Central Eastern Europe.

Para eso necesitamos desbloquear el loop del talento: Hiring, onboarding, formación, crecimiento interno, liderazgo y otra vez hiring. A nivel internacional y en varias compañías en paralelo. Nuestro producto es el talento. Nuestra forma de hacerlo eficiente y escalable es la IA. Qué harás Llevar la selección de principio a fin: definir el perfil, buscar, filtrar, entrevistar y cerrar. Montar y mantener el proceso con IA y automatización: herramientas, plantillas y métricas. Diseñar el onboarding y conectarlo con la formación y el crecimiento interno. Medir lo que importa al negocio: tiempo de contratación, calidad de las incorporaciones y retención. Trabajar con dirección y con los responsables de cada equipo, en varias compañías y países. Qué buscamos De 1 a 3 años en selección, People o RR. HH. operativo, prácticas incluidas, idealmente en consultora, startup o empresa tecnológica. Perfil operativo: te gusta montar procesos y que funcionen. Te gusta la tecnología y ya usas IA o automatizaciones en tu día a día. RR. HH. orientados a negocio: Piensas en resultados, no en trámites. Inglés y español profesional. Suma Experiencia en un entorno internacional o con varias entidades a la vez. Proceso de selección Una llamada corta de presentación, una entrevista presencial y un caso práctico. Qué ofrecemos Contrato indefinido a jornada completa, 25.000-30.000 € brutos al año más variable. Un rol con impacto directo en cómo crece la empresa. Un equipo pequeño, rápido y que usa IA de verdad.

review_candidates.description: Company Description G L Agbomoagan LP is a specialized law firm providing strategic legal solutions across multiple jurisdictions, with core strengths in international law, cross-border practice, hospitality law, and commercial law. The firm advises clients on complex transnational matters, including foreign investment structuring, international dispute resolution, and regulatory compliance in diverse legal systems. Its hospitality practice supports hotels, resorts, restaurants, and tourism operators with licensing, franchise agreements, management contracts, and regulatory guidance. The commercial law team handles mergers and acquisitions, joint ventures, contract negotiations, corporate governance, and commercial disputes. By combining global perspective with local insight and leveraging an international network, G L Agbomoagan LP delivers coordinated legal strategies that support clients’ business goals in a highly interconnected marketplace. Role Description The Senior Trial Attorney is a full-time role responsible for leading complex litigation matters from inception through resolution, with a focus on trial preparation and courtroom advocacy. This hybrid position is based in Ikeja, with a combination of in-office work and remote work as appropriate to case demands. Day-to-day responsibilities include drafting pleadings and motions, managing case strategy, conducting legal research, and appearing in courts for hearings, trials, and other proceedings. The Senior Trial Attorney will take and defend depositions, examine witnesses, collaborate with junior attorneys and support staff, and maintain strong communication with clients regarding case status and strategy. The role also involves mentoring team members, coordinating with external counsel where necessary, and contributing to firm-wide best practices in litigation and dispute resolution. Qualifications Strong foundation in Law, including litigation practice, evidence, and procedural rules. Demonstrated experience drafting and arguing Motions and other key litigation documents. Substantial background appearing in Courts at various levels and managing courtroom procedures. Proven track record handling Trials, including case strategy, witness preparation, and advocacy. Hands-on experience with Depositions, including taking, defending, and analyzing testimony. Minimum of 7–10 years of post-qualification experience in litigation or trial work, preferably in commercial or international matters. Admission to practice law in the relevant jurisdiction and good standing with the bar. Excellent legal research, writing, and analytical skills, with attention to detail and clear communication. Ability to manage multiple complex cases, prioritize workloads, and work effectively in a hybrid environment. Demonstrated leadership, mentoring capability, and collaborative approach to working with colleagues and clients. Experience with cross-border disputes, commercial litigation, or hospitality-related matters is a strong advantage.
